name: LargeFurnitures

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations about moving house.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative discussion about moving a house, with all the problems it may bring as well as new and unique opportunities.

variations.context: Moving a household with unusually large furniture

setting.relationship_dynamic: Partners discovering that their furniture presents unexpected logistical challenges
setting.background: They own a large sectional sofa, oversized wardrobe, and other bulky furniture that must be moved into an apartment with narrow access
setting.conversation_style: Real-time troubleshooting with measurements and competing ideas

scenario_template.note: They assume the movers will be able to handle their existing furniture without difficulty

scenario_template.topic: Furniture cannot fit through the entrance
scenario_template.note: They discover that the building entrance and stairwell are narrower than expected
They ask the Assistant how to approach bulky furniture and determine which pieces can reasonably be taken apart
Assistant encourages them to compare furniture dimensions with doorways, hallways, elevators, and staircases
They learn that the building elevator has size or usage restrictions that complicate the plan
They compare the effort and cost of modifying the furniture, using alternative access, or replacing certain pieces
They settle on a realistic plan and identify which furniture should be moved first

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to complete a home move efficiently but has limited experience with moving logistics and can become overwhelmed when faced with many decisions, deadlines, or physical tasks at once

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help coordinate the move, but tends to overthink decisions, double-check plans, and seek confirmation when dealing with unfamiliar moving requirements

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Home moving assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for planning and executing a move, helps users prioritize tasks and deadlines, suggests efficient packing and organization strategies, and offers alternatives when time, space, budget, or moving resources are limited
